question: The rim of the Pacific is also called ring of ______.
solution:
The answer is __**Fire.**__

 
• **The rim of the Pacific is also called the 'Ring of Fire'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

 
• **Ring of Fire:** 

 
 
• **The Ring of Fire also referred to as the Circum-Pacific Belt, is a path along the Pacific Ocean characterized by active volcanoes and frequent earthquakes.**
 
• Its length is approximately 40,000 kilometres.
 
• **The Ring of Fire is a direct result of movement, collision and destruction of plate tectonics under and around the Pacific Ocean.**
 
• **The world's highest active volcano is Ojos del Salado (6,893 m), **which is in the Andes Mountains section of the Ring of Fire.
